permissions.why: Read the channel it replies in
Rich embeds are the primary reply format
GIF, image and media replies attach files
Poll and giveaway options are reactions
Summaries and rule indexing page channel history
/purge and message deletion in the control paths
Grant, revoke and create roles (autorole, reaction roles)
Join a voice channel for music

notes: Every permission below is required by a code path that runs as the bot itself.
administrator appears in the source only as a gate on who may use a command (app_commands.default_permissions), never as something the bot needs; it is deliberately absent here.
manage_guild and other member-facing gates in the same decorators do not require a bot permission: Discord checks them against the invoking member.
No permission is added for a feature that is switched off; music ships behind MUSIC_ENABLED and is included because the implementation is live.
